reviewer: Independent agent saved-shape, controls and metadata audit; root direct rendered geometry review.
approval_basis: All altered physical solids independently reconstructed from literal dimensions and compared to saved CAD; native controls, placements, unchanged purchased interfaces and print layouts reviewed.
Carrier U legs4mm and centred deck supports remove one-sided bulk. M3 nuts seat2mm into the ordinary carrier while bearing floors and existing fastener lengths are preserved.
Fixed bearing-keeper nut guides become shallow0.5mm recesses; keeper guide0.1mm per side and optical tongue2.4mm/footbore2.2mm reduce location slack without pressing bearing rings.

Ordinary-nut maximum-size insertion and minimum-size turn restraint checked; shallow optical M2 pockets useAF4.25; the input shaft pocket retainsAF4.2 and its1.5mm end wall. Horn pitch-relief slots and intentional moving clearances retained.
Propeller/guard plane15mm, motor plate3mm, motor body+3mm. Inboard straight guard connections preserve full-angle metal reserve without changing18x10x8mm shaft clamps.

Stale manufacturing guard probe corrected fromX12 toX15 with unchanged2mm threshold; former failed candidates and independent reports preserved. The input shaft nut pocket retainsAF4.2 rather than sacrificing its1.5mm end wall.
limits: Regression approval, not physical qualification. PA12 fit, nut chamfers, shaft/keeper centring, motor screw lengths, loaded retention and assembled CG remain to be verified.
